title: Multi-OphthaLingua: A Multilingual Benchmark for Assessing and Debiasing LLM Ophthalmological QA in LMICs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the question-answering accuracy of LLMs on the Multi-OphthaLingua benchmark, which contains manually curated and paired ophthalmological questions translated across 7 different languages (English, Spanish, Portuguese, Filipino, Mandarin, French, and Hindi), to measure performance disparities between High-Income Country (HIC) and Low- and Middle-Income Country (LMIC) languages.

Qualitative analysis of the models' Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning histories by board-certified ophthalmologists to assess how LLMs handle cultural contexts, idiomatic expressions, and region-specific health norms (e.g., differences in post-operative care emphasis between Spanish and English).
